pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polyhedral and sub-rectangular dark regions with smooth pixel gradients at boundaries; patches show variable spatial area with some smaller triangular fragments interspersed among larger blocks.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Network of lighter pathways forming a continuous topological graph with predominantly tri-valent and tetra-valent junction nodes; pathway thickness is thin relative to patch diameter and exhibits significant blue-channel noise.
